.create table bikes_final (
   BikepointID: string,
   Street: string ,
   Neighbourhood: string,
   Latitude: decimal,
   Longitude: decimal,
   No_Bikes: int,
   No_Empty_Docks: int,
   MyTimestamp: datetime 
)
;

.alter table bikes_final policy update @'[{"IsEnabled": true, "Source": "bikes", "Query": "bikes_transform()", "IsTransactional": true}]'

.create-or-alter function bikes_transform() {
    bikes
    | extend MyTimestamp = datetime_add('hour', 2, now())
}

.alter table bikes_final policy update @'[{"IsEnabled": true, "Source": "bikes", "Query": "bikes_transform()", "IsTransactional": true}]'
